core_principles: A scientific dependency is identified by content identity and typed role, never by filesystem path.
A run is a computation DAG plus frozen recipe, not a directory.
Computation dependencies and evidence/claim dependencies are distinct graphs.
Irreplaceable roots are pinned; derived artifacts are rebuildable; checkpoints are disposable unless explicitly promoted to cache.
Deletion eligibility is determined by exact reconstructability plus retention policy, not by age or folder membership.
The graph catalogue is rebuildable from immutable graph records and object-store metadata; SQLite is an index, not sole truth.
Replay is fail-closed on missing, ambiguous, hash-mismatched, version-mismatched, or authority-incompatible dependencies.
Historical paths may be stored as provenance hints but never as dependency identities.
Evidence edges cannot be inferred from computation edges; claim support must be explicit and protocol-authorized.
No garbage collection may delete a node required by any pinned root, certified run, exported publication, or earned claim closure.
name: Infinity Grid Algebra Decoder
purpose: Path-independent reproduction, evidence tracing, minimal preservation, and publication export for the Infinity Grid research programme.
